| $\footnotesize\maroonC{\times\left(-\dfrac13\right)\,\Large\curvearrowright}$ | | $\footnotesize\maroonC{\times\left(-\dfrac13\right)\,\Large\curvearrowright}$ | | $\footnotesize\maroonC{\times\left(-\dfrac13\right)\,\Large\curvearrowright}$ | |
:-: |  :-: | :-: | :-: | :-: | :-: | :-: | :-: | :-:
$27,$ | | $-9,$ | | $3,$ | | $-1,...$

This is the recursive formula of $27\,,-9\,,\,3\,,-1,...$.

$\begin{cases}
b(1)=27
\\\\
b(n)=b(n-1)\cdot\left(-\dfrac13\right)
\end{cases}$
